description: This file contains implementation of logging classes related to Orleans client options, including ClientOptionsLogger and a base class OptionsLogger, which handle logging configuration options and errors, utilizing dependency injection and logging frameworks.

classes.name: ClientOptionsLogger
classes.description: Logger for client options, implements ILifecycleParticipant to participate in cluster client lifecycle events.

classes.name: OptionsLogger
classes.description: Abstract base class providing functionality to log options with formatters, including error handling and integration with dependency injection.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the logger to lifecycle start events.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Logs options when the lifecycle starts.

methods.name: LogOptions
methods.description: Logs all options using registered formatters.

methods.name: LogOptions (overload)
methods.description: Logs options using a provided set of formatters.

methods.name: LogOption
methods.description: Logs a single option formatter, with error handling.
